shared_elements: schematic human-like figures with stick limbs
long curved hook-ended lines (boat-like or hull-like forms)
scattered small motifs without ground line
justification: Both surfaces show small, solidly pecked schematic figures with stick-like limbs, round cup-marks and long curving hook-ended lines strewn over an open rock face with no ground line or framing, and the drawing conventions (silhouette bodies, single-stroke limbs, ladder-like repeated strokes) are closely comparable. The clearest difference is that A contains unambiguous, repeated crewed boats with vertical crew strokes and a large disc-on-pole motif held beside a human, whereas B's forms are more crowded, limb-heavy and ambiguous, with no comparable disc-and-staff or explicit boat-with-crew scheme.
